answer: Proof of space-time curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to reserve and prove persistent storage allocation. An adversary incurs the verifiable hardware cost of maintaining dedicated drive sectors per identity, anchoring digital actors to a basalt foundation of physical media. Auditors strike like a falcon to challenge random indices, holding unverified peers in a quarantine lagoon. However, institutional operators with surplus storage can amass identities at negligible marginal cost.
